Only 5 of 17 themes are trend-gate eligible (frac 0.29, narrowing rotation), breadth is decent but one-narrative flag is false, and absorption is mid-range at 0.45. Scorable proxies are scarce (only China Tech & Internet and China Platform Megacaps via 3033.HK, both ineligible and negative-scored), so all leans here are unscorable and conviction defaults low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Energy (H-shares) overtakes Banks (H + HK) as confirmed leader — the observable condition is Energy's score exceeding Banks' for 5 consecutive sessions while both remain trend-gate eligible, which would retire the watch and shift it to a confirmed handoff.
